note: Jasper County GA (13159) has no public queryable zoning service found. Zoning is shown only in the Schneider qPublic viewer (Zoning layer), which is bot-protected and not a documented REST service. The county planning page says GIS is not yet instituted and the zoning map is available on request. The City of Monticello's official zoning map is obtained by calling the city office; its maps page returns 403. The Jasper County GIS hub found is Jasper County, Missouri, not Georgia. The county code's Official Zoning Map section names no electronic service. Shady Dale and the county's other cities showed no zoning service either.
